question: Separate legal first-sighting goal coupling from residual ordered-history value. Generator-specific memory is real information, not fabrication.
intervention: For circle_permuted, retain native circle starts and the entire native goal set. Rotate goal ownership by 1 + case modulo 4 before any motion. No dynamics/reward/observation changes.
probe_family: Same padded 235-dimensional legal input, 256 shared training-row landmarks and ridge family. Fit and validate separately within each generator, never by test performance.
inference: Case-paired bootstrap. Each primary interval uses 98.3333% confidence (Bonferroni across three regimes for that contrast/endpoint). Equivalence requires the interval inside the prespecified practical margin; nonsignificance is not equivalence. Outcomes remain endpoint-specific.

decision_selection.selection: One first eligible root per case, first 16 eligible test cases in case-ID order. No future or method-result selection.

reward: Frozen native rewards to terminal; Q^pi not Q*. Progress reward remains zero.
interpretation: Removing goal coupling also changes routes via that intervention. Within-regime fits control for the previous OOD-training confound, but empirical failure cannot prove absence of every possible temporal mechanism.
no_training: Only offline predictive probes. No new navigation policy, KDA architecture, IL or RL training.
